Print a loaded model

Source: R/model.R
print.sbert_model.Rd

print() shows a loaded model: the repository id, the pinned revision, the number of embedding dimensions, and the backend. A loaded model is identified by its Hugging Face repository and the revision it is pinned to; together with the embedding dimension and the execution backend, these are what a report needs to state which model produced a set of embeddings.

For the full list of settings of every pinned model, including pooling and prefix, use models(detail = TRUE).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'sbert_model'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An sbert_model from load_model() or load_custom().

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

load_model(); models() for the settings of all pinned models.

Examples

# Repository ids and revisions of the pinned models, without loading one.
